summary: REL-2 complete: main-only GitHub Pages deploy workflow with Pages/OIDC permissions, environment, artifact upload and deploy-pages; single VITE_BASE_PATH input in vite.config.ts; a 641-line Pages build checker with 20 parser/workflow tests; and deployment docs covering URL pattern, base behavior, permissions, exact production preview, troubleshooting and hosting limits. All three required validation commands pass, the Pages build references only /notes-detective/ assets with relative manifest scope and matching icons, and a direct #/settings route loaded from the production preview with HTTP 200.

decisions: Deploy only on push to main; pull requests run CI and never deploy.
Derive the base path from github.event.repository.name in the workflow and normalize a single VITE_BASE_PATH input in vite.config.ts; keep './' as the local default.
Infer the checker's base from index.html when --base is absent so local and Pages builds share one command, while the deploy workflow supplies an explicit base via VITE_BASE_PATH.
Run the Pages build check before artifact upload so a wrong-base build cannot deploy.
interfaces: scripts/check-pages-build.mjs: checkPagesBuild({distDirectory, basePath}), inferBasePath, parseAssetReferences, normalizeBasePath, parseArguments, main.
vite.config.ts: normalizeBasePath(input) and DEFAULT_BASE_PATH='./'; reads process.env.VITE_BASE_PATH.
Tests parse .github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml directly and spawn the checker against temporary build fixtures.

payload.taskDescription: Add .github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml for main with pages:write and id-token:write permissions, an environment, a VITE_BASE_PATH of the repository name, build, artifact upload, and deploy-pages. Update vite.config.ts to read the base path, keep hash routing, and emit relative manifest start_url and scope. Add scripts/check-pages-build.mjs to assert the built index references prefixed assets, the manifest and icons exist, start_url and scope are relative, and no absolute /assets path leaks. Add docs/DEPLOYMENT.md with the Pages URL pattern, base path behavior, permissions, local production preview commands, and troubleshooting. Add tests/release/pagesConfig.test.ts to exercise the check script. Do not add offline E2E.
